description: This source file contains unit tests for the SerializedObjectDAO class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing serialization and deserialization of Program objects using the HibernateSerializedObjectDAO. It verifies object retrieval, saving, deletion, and querying functionalities within the context of database interactions.

classes.name: SerializedObjectDAOTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SerializedObjectDAO implementation in OpenMRS, verifying CRUD operations related to serialization of Program objects within a database context.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initial setup before each test, ensuring serialization service is available and loading initial dataset.

methods.name: getObject_shouldReturnTheSavedObject
methods.description: Test that retrieving an object by ID returns the correct Program instance.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid_shouldReturnTheSavedObject
methods.description: Test that retrieving an object by UUID returns the correct Program instance.

methods.name: saveObject_shouldSaveThePassedObjectIfSupported
methods.description: Test saving a new Program object and verifying it can be retrieved correctly.

methods.name: saveObject_shouldSetAuditableFieldsBeforeSerializing
methods.description: Test that auditable fields like creator and dateCreated are set before serialization.

methods.name: saveObject_shouldThrowAnExceptionIfObjectNotSupported
methods.description: Test that saving an unsupported object type throws an exception.

methods.name: getAllObjects_shouldReturnAllSavedObjectsOfThePassedType
methods.description: Verify retrieval of all non-retired Program objects.

methods.name: getAllObjects_shouldReturnOnlyNonRetiredObjectsOfThePassedTypeIfNotIncludeRetired
methods.description: Verify retrieval of only non-retired objects when specified.

methods.name: getAllObjects_shouldReturnAllSavedObjectsWithTheGivenTypeAndExactName
methods.description: Verify retrieval of objects matching an exact name.

methods.name: getAllObjects_shouldReturnAllSavedObjectsWithTheGivenTypeAndPartialName
methods.description: Verify retrieval of objects with partial name match.

methods.name: purgeObject_shouldDeleteTheObjectWithThePassedId
methods.description: Verify that deleting an object by ID removes it from storage.
